paragraphs: Drivers in Ireland can save money on car insurance. The Central Bank says they can save about €300. They just need to compare prices from different companies.
The bank looked at prices from eight big insurance companies. The same driver often got very different prices. The average price is about €655 a year.
But only 9% of drivers change their insurance company. One in five people do not even call their insurer before they renew.

Some drivers cannot get prices online. This includes new drivers and drivers with penalty points. They can call the company or an agent. The bank also says to check what the insurance covers, not only the price.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭的駕駛人可以在汽車保險上省錢。
中央銀行說他們可以省下約300歐元。
他們只需要比較不同公司的價格。
該銀行查看了八家大型保險公司的價格。
同一個駕駛人常常拿到差異很大的價格。
平均價格約為每年655歐元。
但只有9%的駕駛人更換保險公司。
五分之一的人在續保前甚至沒有打電話給保險公司。
有些駕駛人無法在網上取得報價。
這包括新手駕駛和有違規記點的駕駛。
他們可以打電話給保險公司或代理人。
該銀行也提醒要查看保險的保障範圍，而不只是價格。

paragraphs: Drivers could save around €300 on their car insurance if they shop around, according to new research from the Central Bank. The Central Bank checks and controls banks and insurance companies in Ireland.

It looked at online prices from the eight main insurers, which sell more than 90% of private car insurance in Ireland. It found big differences between insurers for exactly the same driver. The average price for car insurance is about €655.

However, only 9% of drivers switch to a new insurer, and one in five renew without contacting their company at all. More than half of people buy insurance by phoning their insurer, and only 4% use price comparison websites.

Drivers with penalty points or little experience often cannot get a price online, so the bank says they should try a broker. The bank also says people should compare what the insurance covers, not just the price. Insurance Ireland, which represents the insurers, says prices have fallen by more than 5% since last year.
sentZh: 根據中央銀行的新研究，駕駛人若貨比三家，汽車保險可省下約300歐元。
中央銀行負責監督和管理愛爾蘭的銀行與保險公司。
它查看了八家主要保險公司的網上報價，這些公司銷售了愛爾蘭九成以上的私家車保險。
它發現，對完全相同的駕駛人，各保險公司的報價差異很大。
汽車保險的平均價格約為655歐元。
然而，只有9%的駕駛人換到新的保險公司，五分之一的人完全沒聯絡保險公司就續保。
超過一半的人打電話給保險公司購買保險，只有4%使用比價網站。
有違規記點或經驗不足的駕駛人常常無法在網上取得報價，所以該銀行建議他們找保險經紀人。
該銀行也說，民眾應比較保險的保障內容，而不只是價格。
代表保險公司的愛爾蘭保險協會表示，價格自去年以來已下降超過5%。

paragraphs: Motorists could save about €300 a year by shopping around for car insurance, according to research published by the Central Bank. The regulator compared quotes for 16 different types of customer and found wide gaps between insurers for identical drivers.

The study used online quotes for new customers from June, provided by the eight main insurers, which together cover more than 90% of the private motor market. The average premium currently stands at around €655.

Despite the potential savings, just 9% of motorists switch provider, and one in five renew without even contacting their insurer. Most people still buy by phone, while only 4% use price comparison websites.
